caseName: Ham v. Md. Dep't of Pub. Safety & Corr. Servs.
caseNameFull: Doyle R. HAM, Jr. v. MARYLAND DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC SAFETY AND CORRECTIONAL SERVICES

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until December 1, 2014, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance *510with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
